data.title: Payment reminder: locksmith invoice €148.75 due 9 Dec 2026
data.summary: Schlüsseldienst Beispielriegel sent a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for their invoice of 27 October 2026 covering an emergency door opening and cylinder lock replacement on 26 October 2026. They ask Johanna Beispielacker to pay the outstanding €148.75 by 9 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a reminder that an earlier invoice for a locksmith call-out (opening a locked door and replacing the cylinder lock) is still unpaid. You should transfer €148.75 to the locksmith's account using the IBAN given, quoting the order number as reference, by the stated due date. If you already paid, check your bank statement and contact the sender with proof of payment. If the amount or service is disputed, contact the locksmith directly; ignoring the reminder may lead to further reminders or collection steps.
data.tax_note: Craftsman/service costs for a private household (Handwerkerleistungen), such as a locksmith call-out, can be partly tax-deductible under §35a EStG for the labour portion; keep the invoice and proof of bank transfer for your tax return.
